title: 金比羅船々 (Konpira Funefune — Kompira Boat Song)
description: A traditional Japanese parlor game song from Kagawa Prefecture celebrating Kotohira Shrine (金刀比羅宮), guardian of sailors and seafarers. Players place their hands on a table and take turns — when 'シュラシュシュシュ' sounds, the next player must either put their hand flat or raise a fist; the one who fails loses. Still played at traditional banquets (お座敷遊び) today. Edo period origin, anonymous.
